hypotheses.E0_native_gate_is_exact: Native gate reconstruction reaches at least 0.9999 fidelity everywhere.
hypotheses.E1_answer_centroid_span_is_a_causal_quot: The at-most-seven-dimensional answer-centroid span reaches at least 0.70 selected held-out-template fidelity in every run.
hypotheses.E2_answer_span_explains_most_of_rank8_pc: Answer-span fidelity is within 0.20 of rank-8 PCA fidelity on selected held-out-template facts in every run.
hypotheses.E3_answer_prototype_is_behaviorally_suff: The oracle answer-only gate prototype reaches at least 0.90 selected answer accuracy in every run.
hypotheses.E4_answer_prototype_omits_precise_calibr: The oracle answer-only prototype remains below 0.80 selected effect fidelity in every run.
hypotheses.E5_relation_conditioning_adds_little_beh: Adding relation to the oracle gate prototype improves selected answer accuracy by at most 0.05 in every run.
hypotheses.E6_relation_conditioning_adds_precise_ef: Adding relation improves selected effect fidelity by at least 0.05 in every run.
hypotheses.E7_shuffled_answer_span_is_not_causal: A label-shuffled seven-dimensional centroid span remains below 0.30 fidelity everywhere.
hypotheses.E8_within_answer_residual_is_not_an_answ: Global mean plus exact within-answer residual reaches at most 0.60 selected answer accuracy in every run.
hypotheses.E9_rule_and_arbitrary_facts_share_answer: Selected versus unselected answer-span fidelity differs by at most 0.15 in every run.
hypotheses.E10_template_transfer_is_stable: Selected answer-span fidelity differs by at most 0.10 across templates in every run.
hypotheses.E11_signal_gate_passes: Every scored cell contains at least 64 effectful examples.
